description: This file provides a utility function 'getBidiKeyValue' which maps keyboard key names to corresponding Unicode characters or control sequences used in bidirectional communication or input handling within the Playwright project. The function translates key identifiers into Unicode code points, facilitating consistent keyboard input representation in automated browser testing.

methods.name: getBidiKeyValue
methods.description: Maps a given key name string to its corresponding Unicode code point or control sequence used in the bidirectional input context.
